description: Pre-trade check for a crypto perpetual futures order. Send coin, side, size and hold time; returns GO, CAUTION or WAIT with reasons, the cheapest venue by fees and funding rate over your hold (cross-venue), a size limit from 24h volume, funding timing and the market regime. Informational and read-only: places no orders, holds no funds.

coin.description: Asset symbol, e.g. BTC, ETH, SOL.

exchanges.description: Only compare these venues (default: every supported venue).

holdHours.description: Expected holding time in hours (default 8); sets the funding cost window.

side.description: Direction of the order you intend to place: long or short.

name: pre_trade_check
